title: Decision-contrast certification collapses the defensive-backbone gate from a 12-dimensional coefficient problem to a bounded scalar contrast

public_sources.title: Off-Policy Confidence Sequences
public_sources.authors: Nikos Karampatziakis, Paul Mineiro, Aaditya Ramdas
public_sources.use: Time-uniform martingale confidence sequences and gated deployment show that a production upgrade can be decided from sequential evidence without fixing the stopping time in advance. The theorem is not imported directly into the particle-allocation model; it supports the sequential gate motif.

public_sources.title: Closed-form empirical Bernstein confidence sequences for scalars and matrices
public_sources.use: Provides time-uniform confidence sequences for the average conditional mean of bounded observations without requiring a constant mean, supporting an assumption-free certificate for the running-average conditional proxy contrast rather than a next-run contrast.

public_sources.title: Learning Polyhedral Conformal Sets for Robust Optimization
public_sources.authors: Shuyi Chen, Wenbin Zhou, Shixiang Zhu
public_sources.use: Decision-aware uncertainty sets can be aligned with the downstream robust objective while preserving finite-sample validity through independent recalibration. This supports certifying the allocation decision/contrast rather than insisting on a task-agnostic full coefficient set.

public_sources.title: Robust Decision-Focused Learning via Worst-Case Regret Minimization
public_sources.use: Treats uncertainty in objective coefficients through downstream worst-case regret, reinforcing the distinction between coefficient prediction accuracy and decision quality. It is design precedent, not a theorem for the current synthetic particle model.

setup.T: number of generations; r125-r127 engineering regime uses T=12
setup.A: true normalized nonnegative generation coefficient vector on the simplex, available only post hoc in the synthetic harness
setup.d: completed-run normalized continuation diagnostic on the simplex, observable after the run
setup.q0: defensive backbone allocation, fixed before a run; current candidate is beta=0.5
setup.q1: aggressive uncertainty-controller allocation, fixed before the same run
setup.loss: L_x(q)=sum_i x_i/(T*q_i), the same idealized normalized asymptotic-variance objective used in prior role-local allocation comparisons

derived_results.claim: Because d is a simplex vector and q0,q1 are fixed before the completed-run diagnostic is observed, D_d=sum_i d_i*c_i lies exactly in [a,b]=[min_i c_i,max_i c_i]. The range width R=b-a is therefore known predictably for each run and is generally tighter than a global worst-case range. The same statement holds for D_A for any simplex A.

Let mu_t=E[D_t|F_{t-1}] and R_t=b_t-a_t. Hoeffding's conditional lemma gives M_t(lambda)=exp(lambda*sum_{s<=t}(mu_s-D_s)-lambda^2*sum_{s<=t}R_s^2/8) as a nonnegative supermartingale for fixed lambda>0. Ville therefore yields, simultaneously over all t with probability at least 1-alpha, sum mu_s <= sum D_s + lambda*sum R_s^2/8 + log(1/alpha)/lambda. Mixing/stitching or empirical-Bernstein CSs can tighten this. This certifies the running-average conditional proxy contrast under arbitrary time variation, not the next run's conditional contrast.

For q_gamma=(1-gamma)q0+gamma q1 and any simplex x, convexity of 1/q gives L_x(q_gamma) <= (1-gamma)L_x(q0)+gamma L_x(q1)=L_x(q0)+gamma D_x. Thus a negative certified endpoint contrast implies every deterministic blend toward q1 is no worse on that same x; when the endpoint is not certifiably safe, the robust contrast can be evaluated directly for each gamma.

Since A and d are both simplex vectors, sum_i(A_i-d_i)=0. Hence |D_A-D_d|=|c dot (A-d)| <= 0.5*(max c-min c)*||A-d||_1 = R*||A-d||_1/2. Therefore D_A <= D_d + R*epsilon/2 whenever ||A-d||_1<=epsilon. A proxy margin m=-D_d>0 is sufficient for true improvement whenever epsilon < 2m/R. This is an exact deterministic bridge; the unresolved issue is obtaining an anytime or one-step valid epsilon for the independent-stratified particle diagnostic.

If a pre-run coefficient set is a simplex intersected with coordinate bounds L_i<=A_i<=U_i, the worst-case true endpoint contrast max_A c dot A is a linear program with an O(T log T) greedy solution: start at A=L, then allocate remaining mass 1-sum L to coordinates in descending c_i up to capacities U_i-L_i. If this robust gap is <0, q1 is strictly better than q0 for every A in the box. This decision-specific test is weaker than requiring the entire box to satisfy a generic 1.30 variance-inflation constraint and can be repeated over gamma to find the largest conditionally safe blend.

An assumption-free time-uniform CS for the average conditional proxy contrast cannot be reinterpreted as a certificate that E[D_{t+1}|F_t]<0. A next-run gate needs an additional persistence/drift condition, a one-step conditional model, or a current-run coefficient uncertainty certificate. Under an explicit per-run drift bound |mu_t-mu_{t-1}|<=rho, a w-run local-average upper bound can be widened by at most rho*(w-1)/2 to upper-bound the current conditional mean; absent such an assumption, only cumulative/time-average proxy safety should be claimed.

The safety target can be reduced from estimating all T normalized influence coefficients to estimating one scalar contrast c dot A for the concrete q0-vs-q1 decision. This is potentially much easier statistically and matches recent decision-aware uncertainty-set work: certify the direction that changes the decision, while retaining q0 as the always-available backbone. No theorem-clean scalar estimator under the current independent-stratified multi-generation particle dependence has yet been established.

implementation_crosschecks.range_and_blend: 10,000 random T=12 simplex/allocation trials produced zero numerical violations of D in [min c,max c] or the convex blend inequality.
implementation_crosschecks.box_lp: 100 random feasible simplex-box problems were compared with scipy.optimize.linprog; maximum absolute objective discrepancy was 2.220446049250313e-16.
implementation_crosschecks.scope: These are algebra/implementation checks, not new model-specific performance experiments. No new real-agent or AGI performance claim is made.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The average-conditional-mean certificate remains valid under drift but only for the running average; it is not a one-step deployment guarantee.

The L1 bridge is exact conditional on an epsilon bound. The previously observed small mean L1 proxy error is engineering evidence and must not be substituted for a high-probability epsilon certificate.

The greedy box certificate is exact conditional on the box containing the true A. r125-r127 already showed that the current heuristic box can undercover drift, so this is not yet an unconditional variance-safety theorem.
Decision-aware conformal/robust-optimization papers motivate target alignment but their coverage or regret theorems are not transferred to the dependent stratified-particle setting.
No result here establishes real-agent or AGI performance.
frontier: Replace the generic 1.30 conditional box cap with a decision-contrast check in the role-local 12-generation harness: for each pre-run q0,q1 and coefficient box, compute the exact robust gap by the greedy simplex-box LP and, when needed, bisection over gamma for the largest conditionally safe blend.

Instrument the completed-run scalar proxy D_t with its exact predictable [a_t,b_t] and compare a fixed-lambda e-process, a stitched/mixture bound, and a variance-adaptive empirical-Bernstein CS for the running-average conditional proxy contrast. Keep q0 as fallback and label this layer average-proxy-safe only.

Quantify the deterministic bridge margin R_t*||A_t-d_t||_1/2 on disjoint synthetic streams. Search for or derive a theorem-clean one-dimensional confidence sequence/one-step bound for c_t dot A_t under independent stratified particle dependence rather than attempting a full T-dimensional coefficient box first.

If a local drift budget for the scalar conditional contrast can be justified or externally bounded, combine a strongly-adaptive/windowed CS with the rho*(w-1)/2 widening term and validate next-run proxy gating; otherwise do not claim next-run safety.
Explore decision-aware polyhedral/conformal calibration with independent recalibration as a way to orient uncertainty along the small set of allocation contrasts actually queried.
exact_next_action: In the existing role-local 12-generation synthetic harness, compute q0=beta0.5 and q1=the frozen uncertainty-controller proposal before each run. Store c_t, a_t=min c_t, b_t=max c_t, the completed continuation proxy d_t, proxy contrast D_t=c_t dot d_t, post-hoc true contrast c_t dot A_t, and L1 proxy error. First compare the old 1.30 box-cap decision with the exact greedy robust-contrast decision and direct gamma search on discovery streams, freeze the rule, then validate once on disjoint abrupt/gradual/recurring streams. In parallel run an anytime average-conditional proxy CS using exact predictable ranges and report separately: proxy certification time, true-contrast agreement, false upgrades relative to post-hoc A, and cases where the L1 bridge margin would have certified or rejected the upgrade. Do not upgrade the claim from proxy-safe/box-conditional to variance-safe until a valid one-step scalar A-contrast certificate exists.
